title: Memory store (project and user memory)
goal: Persistent project and user memory: Markdown notes the agent can read at start and the user can edit, stored locally with size caps and a refusal to store secrets.
scope_in: Locations: project instructions file `CENTCOM.md` at the repo root (read-only for the store unless the user asks) plus `.centcom/memory/*.md`; user memory `<config dir>/memory/*.md`. File names `^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]{0,63}\.md$`.
API to list, read, write (create/overwrite), append, remove and search (case-insensitive substring, max 50 hits) memory entries; frontmatter `description` (<= 200 chars) used in listings.
Caps: file <= 32 KiB, 200 files per scope, injected context <= 16 KiB total (`render(maxChars)` truncates oldest-first and says so).

Secret guard: `write`/`append` refuse content for which `looksLikeSecret` (lane C005) finds a match or that contains a PEM block or a `cen_live_`/`cen_test_` key, returning `SecretRejected` without echoing the content.
Atomic writes (temp + rename), file mode 0600, directories 0700; project memory dir is added to `.git/info/exclude` unless `memory.commit_project` is true in user config.
`render(scope, maxChars)` returning the text appended to the system prompt (project, then user), each file prefixed with its name and description.
scope_out: Automatic memory extraction from conversations by the model (v1: explicit writes only).
Syncing memory to the backend or teammates: memory is local; never sent over the wire or to telemetry.
build_against: Temp directories with an in-memory or real fs adapter; no network.
interfaces: `createMemoryStore(deps: { fs: MemFs; dirs: { projectRoot?: string; user: string }; log: Logger; config: { commitProject: boolean } }): MemoryStore`

`interface MemoryStore { list(scope: 'project'|'user'): Promise<MemoryMeta[]>; read(scope, name: string): Promise<string | undefined>; write(scope, name: string, content: string): Promise<void>; append(scope, name: string, text: string): Promise<void>; remove(scope, name: string): Promise<void>; search(query: string, scope?): Promise<MemoryHit[]>; render(maxChars?: number): Promise<string> }`
acceptance: `write('user','notes.md', 'api key cen_live_' + 32 chars)` rejects with `SecretRejected` and nothing is written; the error message contains no part of the content.
A 32 KiB + 1 byte write rejects with `TooLarge`; a name `../x.md` or `a/b.md` rejects with `InvalidName`.
`render(16384)` over 40 KiB of entries returns <= 16384 chars, newest files kept, and ends with a marker `[older memory omitted]`.
Writes are atomic: simulated crash between temp write and rename leaves the old content intact; resulting file mode is 0600 on POSIX.
`search('deploy')` returns at most 50 hits ordered by file then line, each hit containing the file name and a <= 200-char snippet.
With default config `.centcom/memory/` appears once in `.git/info/exclude` after the first project write; with `commitProject:true` it does not.
201st file in a scope rejects with `LimitReached`.
guardrails: MUST refuse to persist anything that looks like a secret, and MUST NOT include rejected content in errors or logs.
MUST NOT transmit memory over the network, include it in telemetry, snapshots or `branch.update`; it is local context only.
MUST NOT log memory contents or file names beyond counts.
MUST validate names to prevent path traversal and write only inside the memory directories (realpath check).
Project memory MUST NOT be committed by default.
failure_modes: Disk full / EACCES on write -> typed error, existing file untouched.
Memory dir missing -> created on first write (0700); reads return empty.
Non-UTF-8 file -> skipped in `render` and flagged `unreadable` in `list`.
notes: CENTCOM.md is a product naming choice for the project instructions file; change via ADR if the team prefers another name.
